"""Starter pack for Gicko, generated 2026-09-20 from hardware configuration "FGC2026-Incheon".

Press INIT on the Driver Hub: everything above waitForStart() runs once.
Press START: the while loop runs until STOP.
"""

# ── pyftc:config name="FGC2026-Incheon" fingerprint="c841abeba9d5c0ab" generated="2026-09-20" ──

# ── pyftc:imports ──
from ftc.hardware import CRServo, DcMotor, IMU, RevHubOrientationOnRobot, Servo
from ftc.navigation import AngleUnit
from ftc.opmode import LinearOpMode, TeleOp
# ── pyftc:imports:end ──


# ── Gamepad controls ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#   "Collector": gamepad 1: left stick up/down
#   "shooter": gamepad 1: right stick up/down
#   "Climber": gamepad 1: right trigger forward, left trigger reverse
#   "Fishing": gamepad 1: hold RB forward, hold LB reverse
#   "LB": gamepad 1: hold D-pad up forward, hold D-pad down reverse
#   "RB": gamepad 1: hold D-pad right forward, hold D-pad left reverse
#   "LF": gamepad 1: hold Y forward, hold A reverse
#   "RF": gamepad 1: hold B forward, hold X reverse
#   "chainDrop": gamepad 2: hold RB / hold LB to move it
#   "ChainStop": gamepad 2: hold D-pad up / hold D-pad down to move it
#   "ShooterIntake": gamepad 2: left stick up/down
#   "FixatorRelease": gamepad 2: hold D-pad right / hold D-pad left to move it
#   "imu": gamepad 1 BACK resets the heading to 0
#
# ── Connected hardware ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ── pyftc:hardware ──
# Expansion Hub 2 (address 2, firmware 1.8.2, connected)
#   "Collector" -> self.collector: DcMotor  (REV Robotics UltraPlanetary HD Hex Motor, port 0)
#       560 encoder ticks/rev, 300 max RPM, 20:1 gearing
#   "shooter" -> self.shooter: DcMotor  (REV Robotics UltraPlanetary HD Hex Motor, port 1)
#       560 encoder ticks/rev, 300 max RPM, 20:1 gearing
#   "Climber" -> self.climber: DcMotor  (REV Robotics UltraPlanetary HD Hex Motor, port 2)
#       560 encoder ticks/rev, 300 max RPM, 20:1 gearing
#   "Fishing" -> self.fishing: DcMotor  (REV Robotics Core Hex Motor, port 3)
#       288 encoder ticks/rev, 137 max RPM, 36.25:1 gearing
# Control Hub (address 173, firmware 1.8.2, connected)

@TeleOp(name="Main", group="pyftc")
class Main(LinearOpMode):
    # ── pyftc:devices ──
    collector: DcMotor
    shooter: DcMotor
    climber: DcMotor
    fishing: DcMotor
    lb: DcMotor
    rb: DcMotor
    lf: DcMotor
    rf: DcMotor
    chain_drop: Servo
    chain_stop: Servo
    shooter_intake: CRServo
    fixator_release: Servo
    imu: IMU
    # ── pyftc:devices:end ──

    DRIVE_POWER: float = 1.0      # 0..1, lower it for gentler driving
    MECHANISM_POWER: float = 0.8  # power for button-controlled motors
    SERVO_STEP: float = 0.01      # how far a servo moves per loop while a button is held

    def runOpMode(self) -> None:
        # ── On ready: runs once when INIT is pressed ──
        # ── pyftc:init ──
        self.collector = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "Collector")
        self.shooter = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "shooter")
        self.climber = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "Climber")
        self.fishing = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "Fishing")
        self.lb = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "LB")
        self.rb = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "RB")
        self.lf = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "LF")
        self.rf = self.hardwareMap.get(DcMotor, "RF")
        self.chain_drop = self.hardwareMap.get(Servo, "chainDrop")
        self.chain_stop = self.hardwareMap.get(Servo, "ChainStop")
        self.shooter_intake = self.hardwareMap.get(CRServo, "ShooterIntake")
        self.fixator_release = self.hardwareMap.get(Servo, "FixatorRelease")
        self.imu = self.hardwareMap.get(IMU, "imu")
        # Tell the IMU how the hub is mounted, or the heading will be wrong.
        self.imu.initialize(IMU.Parameters(RevHubOrientationOnRobot(
            RevHubOrientationOnRobot.LogoFacingDirection.UP,
            RevHubOrientationOnRobot.UsbFacingDirection.FORWARD)))
        chain_drop_position = 0.5  # servo jumps here on START; set your starting position
        chain_stop_position = 0.5  # servo jumps here on START; set your starting position
        fixator_release_position = 0.5  # servo jumps here on START; set your starting position
        # ── pyftc:init:end ──

        self.telemetry.addLine("Ready. Press START.")
        self.telemetry.update()
        self.waitForStart()

        # ── On start: loops until STOP is pressed ──
        while self.opModeIsActive():
            # ── pyftc:loop ──
            # "Collector": gamepad 1: left stick up/down
            self.collector.setPower(-self.gamepad1.left_stick_y)
            self.telemetry.addData("Collector", f"power {self.collector.getPower():.2f}")

            # "shooter": gamepad 1: right stick up/down
            self.shooter.setPower(-self.gamepad1.right_stick_y)
            self.telemetry.addData("shooter", f"power {self.shooter.getPower():.2f}")

            # "Climber": gamepad 1: right trigger forward, left trigger reverse
            self.climber.setPower((self.gamepad1.right_trigger - self.gamepad1.left_trigger) * self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            self.telemetry.addData("Climber", f"power {self.climber.getPower():.2f}")

            # "Fishing": gamepad 1: hold RB forward, hold LB reverse
            if self.gamepad1.right_bumper:
                self.fishing.setPower(self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            elif self.gamepad1.left_bumper:
                self.fishing.setPower(-self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            else:
                self.fishing.setPower(0)
            self.telemetry.addData("Fishing", f"power {self.fishing.getPower():.2f}")

            # "LB": gamepad 1: hold D-pad up forward, hold D-pad down reverse
            if self.gamepad1.dpad_up:
                self.lb.setPower(self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            elif self.gamepad1.dpad_down:
                self.lb.setPower(-self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            else:
                self.lb.setPower(0)
            self.telemetry.addData("LB", f"power {self.lb.getPower():.2f}")

            # "RB": gamepad 1: hold D-pad right forward, hold D-pad left reverse
            if self.gamepad1.dpad_right:
                self.rb.setPower(self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            elif self.gamepad1.dpad_left:
                self.rb.setPower(-self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            else:
                self.rb.setPower(0)
            self.telemetry.addData("RB", f"power {self.rb.getPower():.2f}")

            # "LF": gamepad 1: hold Y forward, hold A reverse
            if self.gamepad1.y:
                self.lf.setPower(self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            elif self.gamepad1.a:
                self.lf.setPower(-self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            else:
                self.lf.setPower(0)
            self.telemetry.addData("LF", f"power {self.lf.getPower():.2f}")

            # "RF": gamepad 1: hold B forward, hold X reverse
            if self.gamepad1.b:
                self.rf.setPower(self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            elif self.gamepad1.x:
                self.rf.setPower(-self.MECHANISM_POWER)
            else:
                self.rf.setPower(0)
            self.telemetry.addData("RF", f"power {self.rf.getPower():.2f}")

            # "chainDrop": gamepad 2: hold RB / hold LB to move it
            if self.gamepad2.right_bumper:
                chain_drop_position = min(chain_drop_position + self.SERVO_STEP, 1.0)
            elif self.gamepad2.left_bumper:
                chain_drop_position = max(chain_drop_position - self.SERVO_STEP, 0.0)
            self.chain_drop.setPosition(chain_drop_position)
            self.telemetry.addData("chainDrop", f"position {chain_drop_position:.2f}")

            # "ChainStop": gamepad 2: hold D-pad up / hold D-pad down to move it
            if self.gamepad2.dpad_up:
                chain_stop_position = min(chain_stop_position + self.SERVO_STEP, 1.0)
            elif self.gamepad2.dpad_down:
                chain_stop_position = max(chain_stop_position - self.SERVO_STEP, 0.0)
            self.chain_stop.setPosition(chain_stop_position)
            self.telemetry.addData("ChainStop", f"position {chain_stop_position:.2f}")

            # "ShooterIntake": gamepad 2: left stick up/down
            self.shooter_intake.setPower(-self.gamepad2.left_stick_y)
            self.telemetry.addData("ShooterIntake", f"power {self.shooter_intake.getPower():.2f}")

            # "FixatorRelease": gamepad 2: hold D-pad right / hold D-pad left to move it
            if self.gamepad2.dpad_right:
                fixator_release_position = min(fixator_release_position + self.SERVO_STEP, 1.0)
            elif self.gamepad2.dpad_left:
                fixator_release_position = max(fixator_release_position - self.SERVO_STEP, 0.0)
            self.fixator_release.setPosition(fixator_release_position)
            self.telemetry.addData("FixatorRelease", f"position {fixator_release_position:.2f}")

            # "imu": BACK resets the heading
            if self.gamepad1.back:
                self.imu.resetYaw()
            heading = self.imu.getRobotYawPitchRollAngles().getYaw(AngleUnit.DEGREES)
            self.telemetry.addData("imu heading", f"{heading:.1f} deg")

            # ── pyftc:loop:end ──
            # Live gamepad readout, handy for checking which button is which
            self.telemetry.addData("Gamepad 1 sticks", f"L ({self.gamepad1.left_stick_x:.2f}, {self.gamepad1.left_stick_y:.2f})  R ({self.gamepad1.right_stick_x:.2f}, {self.gamepad1.right_stick_y:.2f})")
            self.telemetry.addData("Gamepad 1 triggers", f"L {self.gamepad1.left_trigger:.2f}  R {self.gamepad1.right_trigger:.2f}")
            self.telemetry.addData("Gamepad 1 A/B/X/Y", f"{self.gamepad1.a} {self.gamepad1.b} {self.gamepad1.x} {self.gamepad1.y}")
            self.telemetry.addData("Runtime", f"{self.getRuntime():.1f} s")
            self.telemetry.update()
